profile: Senior IT professional and full-stack engineer with 10+ years across enterprise IT, software development and automotive manufacturing. Combining hands-on engineering (Angular, TypeScript, Node.js, .NET, SQL, Keycloak) with Agile delivery, stakeholder management and cross-departmental leadership to align technology with business outcomes. As BRM and project lead at Mercedes-Benz, led a datacenter transformation that reduced a planned five-year budget from €1.5M to €170k while maintaining SLAs and operational stability. Track record of modernising platforms, introducing CI/CD and enabling high-performing teams across technical and non-technical stakeholders.

projects.title: Datacenter Transformation
projects.description: Re-engineered a five-year datacenter modernisation programme. Rescoped the target architecture around critical business requirements, secured executive buy-in for a lean infrastructure approach and led third-party service-provider management — keeping production IT stable throughout.

projects.title: Engineering ↔ IT Business Relationship Management
projects.description: Single point of accountability between the Engineering division and central IT. Translate engineering roadmaps into actionable IT demand, navigate departmental silos under high-pressure negotiations, and mentor cross-functional project teams while managing external providers against SLAs.

projects.title: ROCKETS Platform Consolidation
projects.description: Drove the consolidation of three independent crowd-investing platforms into a single unified ROCKETS brand serving ~50,000 registered investors across Austria, Germany and Switzerland. Merged three legacy JSP frontends into one Angular app, unified Java backends and data models, and replaced a custom auth system with Ory Kratos — adding self-service registration, recovery and MFA aligned to GDPR.

projects.title: Logistics Dashboard & Firmenradl MVP
projects.description: Delivered client engagements across Austria and Germany in a Scrum setting. Contributed frontend components and backend integrations to a logistics management dashboard for Mercedes-Benz, and built the first MVP for Firmenradl.at — a corporate bicycle leasing platform — using WEBCON as the backend workflow engine.

projects.title: Manufacturing Execution System (MES)
projects.description: Supported and extended the internal Manufacturing Execution System (MES) running the production floor. Connected new production lines, ran 3rd-level support for operators, and contributed to the planning team deciding and rolling out new lines.

about.intro: I'm Georg — a Diplom-Ingenieur and full-stack engineer currently working as IT & Software Professional at Mercedes-Benz G GmbH. From summer 2026 I'll be based in Krems an der Donau and available for selected consulting engagements across the DACH region.
about.story: My path is unusual: I started on the shop floor as a body-shop technician at Magna Steyr, led a 20-person night-shift team, then served as a KIOP/KPE contract soldier with a six-month KFOR tour in Kosovo before pivoting into software engineering. That background shows up in how I work — calm under pressure, direct communication, and a strong bias for outcomes over theatre.

subHighlights: Bridging Engineering and IT departments, aligning conflicting stakeholder interests with strategic business goals and digitalisation roadmaps.
Navigating departmental silos and high-pressure negotiations to deliver consensus on infrastructure and tooling decisions.
Mentoring cross-functional project teams and managing external service providers against defined SLAs.
Managing project backlogs and documentation in JIRA and Confluence.
Re-engineered a five-year project scope, reducing the planned budget from €1.5M to €170k (88% saving) while maintaining full operational stability.
Secured executive buy-in for a lean infrastructure approach by prioritising critical requirements over legacy scope.
Primary lead for datacenter operations and third-party service provider management.
Architecting and deploying internal applications using Angular, Node.js/NestJS, MSSQL and Keycloak authentication.
Tech stack: TypeScript, SCSS, Jest, Express, WebSocket, Electron.

employment.title: Full-Stack Developer
highlights: Drove the consolidation of three independent crowd-investing platforms into a single unified brand (ROCKETS), serving ~50,000 registered investors across Austria, Germany and Switzerland.

Executed the full-stack platform merge: migrated three legacy JSP frontends into one Angular application, unified Java backends and data models, and introduced GitLab CI/CD pipelines for continuous delivery.

Replaced a custom-built authentication system with Ory Kratos, introducing self-service registration, account recovery and MFA/2FA — reducing identity-related support tickets and aligning with GDPR requirements.
Designed network infrastructure for office relocation and negotiated ISP contracts.
Built a centralised hardware/software inventory and structured onboarding process, reducing new-hire ramp-up time.
Tech stack: Angular, TypeScript, Java, JSP, Ory Kratos, GitLab CI/CD.

employment.title: Full-Stack Developer
highlights: Delivered client projects ranging from two months to three years for customers in Austria and Germany, working across Angular, React, React Native, .NET and Dojo Toolkit.
Contributed to a logistics management dashboard for Mercedes-Benz, delivering frontend components and integrating with backend services.
Built the first MVP for Firmenradl.at, a corporate bicycle leasing platform, using WEBCON as the backend workflow engine.
Worked in Scrum teams with sprint planning, daily stand-ups and story estimation across all engagements.
Tech stack: Angular, React, React Native, .NET, Dojo Toolkit, WEBCON.
